name: dealhound
description: Discover physical products with your agent and prepare disclosed Amazon purchase links. Free, no account or checkout automation.

interface.longDescription: Tell your agent what you want or confirm shopping interests from context you authorize. Your agent uses its available browsing tools to discover physical products. DealHound prepares Amazon.com product links with affiliate attribution and a clear disclosure. No DealHound account or subscription. We may earn commissions at no extra cost to you. Prices and availability must be checked with the retailer. DealHound does not buy products or run background monitoring. Skimlinks and additional merchant support are pending.
defaultPrompt: Help me find a quiet mechanical keyboard under $100.
Find deals for the shopping interests we discussed.
Ask me what products I am interested in.
